description: A small game layer on top of yak2d: screens, canvases and layers, render passes, entities with components, and Box2D physics (Box2D.NET).

Firebase Cloud Messaging integration for DotBoil applications. Stores FCM registration tokens of authenticated users per device and sends push notifications by UserId, automatically cleaning up expired tokens.

A test-framework-agnostic helper layer over Appium for .NET MAUI (and other mobile) UI tests: element lookup by automation id, resilient waits, precise no-fling gestures, waiting assertions with useful failure messages, hybrid WebView support, and local/cloud session setup. Works with NUnit, xUnit,…

The app-side half of Appium.Harness for .NET MAUI: TestProbe publishes chosen view properties — a colour, a bound view-model value — into the platform accessibility tree, so an Appium test can assert on them with Appium.Harness's HasTextColor and HasProperty. Off unless the app opts in with UseTest…
A Serilog sink that writes events to a LogStream server (guibranco/logstream-server) in batches.
Markdown, HTML and PDF importers for Adoc.Net: convert to AsciiDoc source with extracted media and a per-document fidelity report.

BCC Privacy for ASP.NET Core: the privacy scope per request from the signed-in organisation and the endpoint's declared process, refusal of endpoints that read personal data without a process, and per-endpoint masking of data items in JSON responses.
